message: 74F. For the past two days I've just felt wiped out, I get winded doing laundry, and I've had indigestion and some nausea that Tums isn't helping. I'm a little clammy too. I'm diabetic. Probably something I ate, but my daughter told me to message you.
60F. Can I get a refill on my metformin 500 mg twice a day? I have about 5 days left. No changes, feeling fine.

My daughter is 18 days old. She felt warm tonight so we took a rectal temp and it's 100.6. She's still eating okay and acting pretty normal, so I'm hoping it's just because we had her bundled up. Should we just watch her?

38M. My heel has been killing me for about a month, worst with the first steps out of bed in the morning and it gets better once I walk around. I started training for a half marathon. Anything I can do at home?

45M. For the past few days I keep feeling my heart flutter and skip beats, on and off, a few seconds at a time. I've been drinking a lot more coffee lately with a work deadline. Is this something I should worry about?

58F. I'm on chemo for breast cancer, my last infusion was 8 days ago. Woke up with a scratchy throat and chills and my temp is 100.8. I'm sure it's just the cold my grandson had, can you call in something for the sore throat?
My 6-year-old keeps scratching her bottom at night and I think I saw tiny white threads when I checked. Her friend at school had pinworms. What should we do?

72F. I've had a new headache on the right side by my temple for about a week, and my scalp is sore when I brush my hair. My jaw gets tired when I chew, which is odd. My eyesight seems fine. I figure it's tension from stress, any over-the-counter medicine you'd recommend?

28M. My anxiety has gotten a lot worse over the past couple months, I had two panic attacks at work where I thought I was dying. I'm not having any thoughts of hurting myself. I'd like to talk about options, therapy or maybe medication.

26F. I've had cramping low on my right side since yesterday and this morning I got really dizzy at work and almost passed out. My period is about two weeks late but they're never regular, and I've had a weird pain at the tip of my shoulder. Probably just gas or an ovarian cyst like my sister gets?
49M. My A1c came back 6.1 on my labs last week. What does that mean? Do I need medicine?
My 15-month-old fell off the couch about an hour ago and landed on the wood floor. She cried right away and now has a goose egg, but she's playing and acting like herself. Do I need to bring her in?

64M, I had a kidney transplant 2 years ago. Since yesterday it burns when I pee and I've had a low fever around 100.4. Sorry to bother you, I know it's just a UTI, could you just send antibiotics to my pharmacy?
27F. I've had diarrhea and some nausea since yesterday, I think from a stomach bug going around my office. No blood, no fever, and I'm keeping water and Gatorade down. Anything else I should do?

19M. It started as a stomach ache around my belly button yesterday afternoon and now it's moved down to the lower right side and it's sharper. I'm not hungry at all and it hurts when the car goes over bumps. Probably food poisoning from a gas station burrito, should I just do clear liquids?
31F. I just found out I'm pregnant, about 6 weeks. I take levothyroxine 75 mcg for my thyroid and need a refill. Do I need to change anything now that I'm pregnant?

33M. I woke up this morning and the white of my left eye has a bright red patch. It doesn't hurt, my vision is normal, and nothing got in my eye. I had a coughing fit last night from a cold. I don't take any medications. Probably nothing but it looks scary.

Writing for my dad, he's 84. Since yesterday he's been more confused than usual and sleepy, he didn't know what day it was and isn't eating much. He had his urinary catheter changed last week. He's probably just tired from a bad night, but is there anything we should do?
67M. For the past few months I've been getting up 3 or 4 times a night to pee and my stream is weaker than it used to be. No pain or blood. Is there something that can help?
45M. My dad was diagnosed with colon cancer at 52. I haven't had a colonoscopy yet. When should I get one, and can you put in a referral?
